# A.S. Traders

> A.S. Traders is a wholesale supplier and distributor of veterinary feed supplements, cattle mineral mixtures, rumen buffers, and livestock nutrition products based in Moga, Punjab, India.

A.S. Traders supplies dairy farmers, commercial feed millers, and veterinary stockists across India with feed-grade nutritional supplements designed to enhance milk yield, improve reproductive fertility, prevent metabolic acidosis, and support skeletal health.

## Core Products & Documentation
- [R.S. RAKSHAK](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Cattle feed additive combining yeast MOS, sodium bicarbonate, and bentonite for rumen buffering, toxin binding, and milk yield support.
- [R.S. MIN FORTE CHELATED](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Amino acid chelated mineral and vitamin supplement powder for high-yielding dairy cattle.
- [CALCIUM PHOS AD3 PLUS](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): High-potency calcium (26%), phosphorus (16%), and Vitamin A/D3 supplement for cattle and poultry.
- [CAL-PHOS D.C.P.+](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Feed-grade dicalcium phosphate supplement with zinc and iron for bone mineralization and eggshell quality.
- [HEAT-FORTE Cattle Powder](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Veterinary reproductive feed supplement for estrus induction and breeding conditioning.
- [R.S. DIGESTIVE MIXTURE](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Ayurvedic herbal stomach powder for indigestion, gas, and bloat relief in livestock.
- [R.S. CAL-12+ Liquid](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Bioavailable liquid calcium (35,000 mg/L) and Vitamin D3 tonic for lactation support and milk fever prevention.
- [FERRICAL-L Liquid](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Liquid iron, calcium, and lysine tonic for red blood cell formation and calf vitality.
- [R.S. BUFF Supplement](https://www.as-traders.in/#products): Advanced rumen buffer with sodium bicarbonate, magnesium oxide, and liver extracts to prevent acidosis.
